caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition bordered by a thin black outline. At the top inside the rectangle, there is a decorative horizontal band filled with alternating large green leaf-like shapes and a green diagonal stripe pattern below them. Within the main section of the rectangle, there are four sets of stylized designs positioned symmetrically: two near the upper middle and two near the lower middle. Each of these designs incorporates abstract green leaf or petal shapes, small red marks that resemble petals or flames, as well as some round and oval green dots. The lower designs feature a central red diamond shape, while the upper designs have green round dots within the pattern. At the center of the rectangle is a small symmetrical green motif composed of four oval shapes that form a cross. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Stencilled Wall
